fields.v: Yes (1): all 31 instruction-category combinations and two models evaluated under the same harness, prompts and libraries (alternatives under the same conditions); no no-agent-file baseline
fields.quote: We systematically evaluate all 31 non-empty combinations of five instruction categories using AI agents with two Large Language Models (LLMs) across five Python libraries: areyoustillthere, audiodiff, autolink, bitmap, and compactor.
fields.why: Q7 asks for a baseline or an alternative under the same conditions; the 31 combinations and two models are alternatives run under identical settings, so the missing no-file baseline may not justify Partly.
fields.doubt: A Q7 aceita 'baseline ou alternativa nas mesmas condições'. Aqui há 31 combinações e 2 modelos com o mesmo harness, prompts e bibliotecas, só falta um baseline sem ficheiro de agente. Decide se isso basta para Sim ou se manténs Parcial (vê pág. 2-4).
